packetModel.positiveMeaning: a concrete deny witness in the observed compatible INPUT chains
packetModel.negativeMeaning: all symbolic ports accepted within the declared model or no observed INPUT filtering
packetModel.unknownMeaning: manual with firewall_active retained in incompleteChecks

limitations: This is not full Linux distribution, architecture or vulnerability coverage
IPv4 deny witness does not establish IPv6 or external reachability
Native controls run only on owned disposable CI machines; no production hosts were modified
Other failed/manual findings remain even when firewall_active passes
Package metadata controls establish specific detector behavior, not overall CVE precision or recall
Source artifact retention is limited; hashes and exact source/run identity are preserved here
